gpu: Shared A800 under existing memory/thermal admission. Additional prelaunch observations of load and reserved memory. No exclusive-device or standardized runtime comparison. At most 90 min per training arm and 30 min per evaluation.
inference: 5000 percentile bootstrap draws, seed 2026112308 per split; average channel draws before resampling sources (fixed tuple anchors in 4B). Pointwise intervals conditional on these frozen weights, no distribution over training seeds.

noma.constant: Frozen full weights, common first solve, two complete latent-prior/gate rounds and two new LMMSE solves per arm. Each round receives its own preceding state.
noma.native: Reuse native per-event scores only after checking hashes and replaying first batch for each split/seed; max allowed 0.003 dB PSNR and 0.00005 DISTS per replay position; otherwise recompute the native arm and retain diagnostics.
noma.pairing: Previously published cyclic tuple construction and image/channel hash checks. Equal airtime. Each user is scored.
noma.positive_check: With neither factor, repeated solves match stage one of this frozen checkpoint.
noma.primary: Weak user PSNR: both minus covariance-only. DISTS, other users, both minus cancel-only, marginal contrasts and factorial interaction reported.

wave.budget: 12288 complex resource elements, 13056 time samples including cyclic prefix per image. 1/16 per RGB component before cyclic prefix. No extra channel uses or receiver side information.
wave.selection: Final step 7000 in both arms, independent of validation ranking.
wave.test: common500 and Kodak24 separately, 10 dB, kd_max=0.10 and 0.18. Three producer channel draws 5001/5002/5003 per source. Primary comparison spread minus no_spread at 0.10, both PSNR and DISTS, report the full table.
wave.train: Both arms train from identical adapter values on train20k; same recorded per-step draws. Frozen Swin encoder/backbone, 2D estimator, refiner and downstream frame-uniform reliability in both arms. Only payload ISFFT and inverse SFFT differ. Features of the 2D refiner remain local and identical in design.
